title: No parking, no HSRP, double parking or rash driving
summary: A clear, evidence-first route for reporting unsafe driving and traffic violations in Maharashtra.

sections.heading: Report to
sections.body: Send the complaint to the traffic police for the city where the incident happened. For Mumbai, use Mumbai Traffic Police. For Thane, use the area traffic unit or Thane Traffic Control. For Pune, use Pune Traffic Police. If someone is in immediate danger, call 112 first.

channels.name: Mumbai Traffic Police
channels.contact: Official Mumbai Traffic Police app / WhatsApp 8454 999 999

sections.heading: How to report
sections.body: Choose the official traffic channel, select the closest violation type, attach the evidence and submit the exact location. Ask for the complaint number and keep it for follow-up. Send separate reports when there are several unrelated violations.
steps: Open the official traffic police app or city traffic WhatsApp channel.
Write what happened in one line: violation, road, landmark and direction of travel.
Attach the photo or video and vehicle number, if readable.
Save the acknowledgement or complaint number.

sections.heading: Evidence to keep
sections.body: Capture a clear photo or short video showing the vehicle number plate, the violation and the surrounding landmark. Note the date, time and exact location. Do not put yourself in danger or confront the driver.

sections.heading: If there is no response
sections.body: Follow up using the complaint number, then contact the traffic unit or DCP Traffic for that city. If the complaint is still ignored, use the Maharashtra public grievance route and attach your earlier acknowledgement.

title: Illegal hawkers or encroachment in Thane
summary: Report blocked footpaths, roads and public spaces to the relevant Thane Municipal Corporation ward office with evidence.

sections.heading: Report to
sections.body: Your respective Thane Municipal Corporation ward office or the TMC Encroachment (Atikraman) department. Road obstruction can also be reported to the local police.

sections.heading: How to report
sections.body: File a ward-level complaint with the exact spot, nearest landmark and what is being obstructed. Mention whether the issue affects pedestrians, traffic, an entrance, an emergency access route or a public footpath. Ask for a complaint number.
steps: Identify the ward and exact location.
Attach dated photos or video from a safe place.
Submit to the ward office / TMC grievance channel.
Keep the acknowledgement and follow up with the Assistant Commissioner if needed.

sections.heading: Evidence to keep
sections.body: Use wide and close photos showing the obstruction, road name, landmark and date/time. Avoid arguments with vendors; document the public obstruction instead.
checklist: Close photo of the stall or structure

sections.heading: If there is no response
sections.body: Escalate from the ward office to the Assistant Commissioner, then the Municipal Commissioner. Attach the original complaint number and all evidence. Use Aaple Sarkar for a written escalation if the municipal route does not respond.

title: Illegal hawkers or encroachment in Mumbai
summary: Use the BMC ward office and its grievance channels to report blocked roads, footpaths and public spaces.

sections.heading: Report to
sections.body: Your respective Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) ward office, especially the License / Encroachment department. A road obstruction can also go to the local police.

sections.heading: How to report
sections.body: Select the civic encroachment or obstruction category, pin the location, add evidence and describe the public access being blocked. Ask for the complaint number and keep the acknowledgement.
steps: Identify the BMC ward and exact location.
Attach photos showing the public obstruction and surrounding landmark.
Submit through 1916 or the official BMC grievance channel.
Follow up with the ward office Assistant Commissioner using the complaint number.

sections.heading: Evidence to keep
sections.body: Take a wide photo showing the road or footpath and a close photo showing the obstruction. Note date, time, ward and landmark. Do not confront anyone or put yourself at risk.

sections.heading: If there is no response
sections.body: Escalate to the ward Assistant Commissioner, then the BMC Public Grievance Cell or Municipal Commissioner. Include the original complaint number and use Aaple Sarkar if the municipal route remains unresolved.

title: Illegal hawkers or encroachment in Pune
summary: Start with your Pune Municipal Corporation ward office and attach evidence that shows the obstruction and location.

sections.heading: Report to
sections.body: Your respective Pune Municipal Corporation ward office or the PMC Encroachment department. For an active road blockage or immediate safety risk, also inform the local police.

channels.name: Pune Municipal Corporation
channels.contact: Use the official PMC website / ward office grievance channel

sections.heading: How to report
sections.body: State the ward, road, landmark and the public access being blocked. Upload clear evidence and request a complaint number so the report can be tracked.
steps: Identify the PMC ward and exact spot.
Photograph the obstruction from a safe public place.
Submit to the PMC ward office or official grievance channel.
Follow up with the ward officer / Encroachment department using the acknowledgement.

sections.heading: Evidence to keep
sections.body: Keep dated photos or video, exact location, nearby landmark and a short description of the obstruction. Do not argue with vendors or record people unnecessarily.

sections.heading: If there is no response
sections.body: Escalate to the ward officer and PMC senior grievance officer. Attach proof of the first complaint. For a Maharashtra government escalation, use Aaple Sarkar.

title: A government employee asks for a bribe
summary: Preserve the details and report a bribe demand to the Anti-Corruption Bureau Maharashtra before paying whenever possible.

sections.heading: Report to
sections.body: The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) Maharashtra and the local ACB office under the jurisdiction where the demand happened, such as ACB Thane, Mumbai or Pune. Central government employees may need a CVC / CBI route instead.

sections.heading: What to do first
sections.body: Do not pay or promise money just to create evidence. Contact ACB for instructions; they may verify the demand and arrange lawful action. If there is an immediate threat, call 112.
steps: Write down exactly what was demanded and by whom.
Contact ACB Maharashtra as soon as possible.
Follow the ACB officer's instructions about any recording or trap.
Keep the complaint acknowledgement and the name of the office handling it.

sections.heading: Evidence to keep
sections.body: Capture or preserve evidence only when it is safe and lawful. Keep the officer's name, designation, badge or vehicle number, office, amount, date, time and location. Preserve messages, call details, documents and any recording without editing it.

sections.heading: If there is no response
sections.body: Follow up with the ACB divisional office for the district. You can also write to the department vigilance cell or Lokayukta Maharashtra. Keep the original submission and all follow-up acknowledgements.

title: Unsafe, stale, adulterated or contaminated food
summary: Report food safety problems in Maharashtra with the evidence the Food Safety Officer needs to inspect the business.

sections.heading: Report to
sections.body: Report to Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the district where the food was sold. You can also use the FSSAI grievance route. For a refund or compensation, complain to the restaurant / delivery app and then the National Consumer Helpline.

sections.heading: How to report
sections.body: Describe the food, seller, date and location. Upload the bill, packaging and photos. Mention whether anyone became ill and whether the food is still available for inspection.
steps: Complain to the restaurant or delivery app in writing and keep the ticket.
Submit the same evidence to Maharashtra FDA or FSSAI.
Keep the complaint number and any medical records.
Use the consumer route if you need a refund or compensation.

sections.heading: Evidence to keep
sections.body: Do not discard the food if it is safe to preserve. Photograph or video the food, bill, packaging, label, premises and date. If anyone fell ill, seek medical care first and keep prescriptions and bills.

sections.heading: Helpline and email
sections.body: Keep this contact block editable as the FDA publishes updates. Add the current Maharashtra FDA district helpline and email here after verifying them on the official FDA website. Do not rely on an unverified number copied from social media.

sections.heading: If there is no response
sections.body: Follow up with the district Food Safety Officer and Maharashtra FDA using the acknowledgement. For illness, serious harm or compensation, also use the National Consumer Helpline and seek appropriate medical or legal help.
